# System Intelligence & Strategic Tactics (SIST)

> System Intelligence & Strategic Tactics is an AI-oriented intelligence architecture for structured research, adversarial review, strategic synthesis, and decision support.

## Canonical website
https://systemintelligenceandstrategictactics.com/

## Core concepts
- Structured intelligence workflow
- Multi-perspective AI Council
- Adversarial review and challenge
- Intelligence synthesis
- Specialized analytical divisions
- Research, briefings, and interactive system documentation
